name: Feature request

title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem would this solve?

Describe the situation you run into. ("I have to open the Actual app separately every time I want to...")

## What would you like to happen?

A clear description of the feature or change.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're currently using, or other ways this could be solved.

## Would this need a new optional config?

This project's philosophy is that new panels/behaviors should be **off by default** and controlled by an optional JSON config file (like `goals.json`) so households that don't want them see no change. If your idea fits that pattern, say so — it'll be easier to design.

## Anything else?

Screenshots, mockups, or examples from other tools are welcome.
